name: ATLAS-W — Direct Control and Three Batteries
scope: Eight new product files under atlas_w_playable/live only. Earlier modules, shared owners and prior immutable URLs are unchanged. The new isolated host deliberately changes visible-stall handling and graphics.

controls.rightMouseDrag: Direct manual turret traverse/elevation in first-person, third-person and whole-ship views
controls.lockMouse: Optional user-requested pointer lock; mouse movement aims, left click fires; denial/unsupported leaves drag fallback
controls.WASD_or_arrows: Drive and steer concurrently with aiming and firing
controls.leftMouse_or_Space: Fire; hold for repeat after selected gun cooldown
controls.G_or_brackets: Select next or previous of three twin gun stations
controls.1_2_3: First-person operator, third-person operator, ship view
controls.mobile: Left driving pad, right aim-swipe area and separate Fire; independent pointers

guns.basePlacement: Visual bases attached using actual original deck triangle intersections; not structural or full-body clearance acceptance
guns.operator: One existing seated avatar remains at the bow console. Side guns are selected remotely; no walking or duplicate gunner claimed.

visualChanges: Procedural projected paint, roughness and bump maps with panel seams and subtle streaks
Non-slip deck grain and subtle waterline tint
Source-surface-attached deckhouse doors, louvres, handles, instanced fasteners and navigation-light housings
Beveled turret shells, layered cheeks, barrel collars, supports and detail rings
Batched static detail rather than one draw object per small fitting
Water shading normals follow the same analytic waves as displacement; softened foam-wake alpha
Smaller action HUD, camera alternatives in Options, requested/actual direction indicators

timePolicy.visibleLongFrame: Discard elapsed debt instead of automatically leaving the voyage paused; the next normal fixed steps continue

tests.retainedBaselineQualification: Executed separately against unchanged previous baseline modules, not 122 new-product acceptance cases
tests.scope: Local Node v22.16.0, actual Three/source GLB/avatar geometry and source-loop excerpts, with synthetic DOM/events and test-only image-decoding bypass. No browser/GPU/native input.

retainedCorrections: The first weak paired probe measured actuator drift and passed both versions; a corrected probe asserts requested-angle change before actual-angle movement, with identical before/after assertions.
One paired rerun used a wrong relative import path and failed before execution; retained separately. Corrected invocation produced original failure/new pass.
Source hashing caught and corrected an instanced-detail transcription error and restored the tested practice-target geometry before final release.
Removed an irrelevant local Escape check on pointer events to match published controls; full product suite reran successfully.
publicReceipt: Ordinary web-reader access to the exact public URL was unavailable. Git source publication confirmed; public HTTP and rendered behavior are not verified.
limits: No new browser, CI or workflow execution; earlier blocked automation was not retried or routed around.
No rendered screenshots, GPU shader compilation, native pointer-lock/touch, physical phone, Safari, hardware-audio or performance verification.
This is not GTA-level visual quality, a new open-world engine, or a photorealistic overhaul.
Original ship and projectile coefficients unchanged; damage remains simplified practice-target/water impacts.
No full-body fit, collision, structural or ergonomic approval; prior HUMANS/CORE acceptance does not transfer.
Additional guns are fictional game content, not real weapon performance data or operational training.
Manual/background pause still needs Resume; a slow renderer can still slow simulation.
Older immutable links do not automatically update.
